description:
Navratri 2026 was a celebration of vibrant colours, rhythmic beats and joyful togetherness. 💃🕺 On the evening of 16th October 2026, RCMP members and their families, dressed in their finest ethnic wear, danced their hearts out with Dandiya sticks to the dhol and traditional tunes.
🏆 Congratulations to our winners for Best Solo Dancers, Best Couple Dancers and Best Traditional Outfits!
🙏 Heartfelt thanks to the organising team, PP Rtn. Moha Kamat, PP Rtn. Dr. Monika Tandon and First Lady RotAnne Renuka Gokhale, for the Aarti arrangements, beautiful hall decorations and delicious festive food. Above all, thank you to every member and family who joined in. Your energy made the night truly special!
